data.long_description:
Villa for Sale in Caya, Arabian Ranches 3

Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional 4-bedroom standalone villa in Caya, Arabian Ranches 3 — one of the most premium villa communities by Emaar.

Set on a large plot of 5,298 sq ft with a BUA of 4,060 sq ft, this villa offers generous living spaces, modern design, and the privacy of a standalone home, making it ideal for families seeking comfort and exclusivity.

Property Features:
4 Bedrooms
Maid’s Room
BUA: 4,060 Sq ft
Plot: 5,298 Sq ft
Standalone Villa
Spacious Living & Dining Areas
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
Private Garden
Covered Parking
Modern Finishes

Community Highlights:
Located in Caya – a premium villa community in Arabian Ranches 3
Close to Central Park, pool, and gym
Easy access to community center & retail outlets
Family-friendly environment with landscaped greenery and walking trails

This is a rare opportunity to own/live in a standalone villa with a large plot in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities, offering the perfect balance of privacy, space, and lifestyle.
